title: Matrixyl 3000 Firming Serum

seo.title: Matrixyl 3000 Serum for Firmer-Looking Skin | Skingenetix
seo.description: Matrixyl 3000 firming serum with pentapeptide-4, hyaluronic acid and vitamin C for firmer, smoother-looking skin and softer lines. Morning and evening.

description_html:
A collagen-support serum pairing Matrixyl 3000 peptides with hyaluronic acid for firmer, smoother, plumper-looking skin.

  • Matrixyl 3000 (Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1 & Tetrapeptide-7) - matrikine peptides associated with the skin's collagen activity
  • Supports firmer, smoother, plumper-looking skin
  • No parabens · no mineral oil · no synthetic fragrance

Best for: fine lines and skin losing firmness, for anyone wanting a lightweight, twice-daily firming step.
custom.key_benefits:
- Firms & plumps - supports the look of firmer, plumper skin
- Smooths fine lines - helps soften the appearance of fine lines
- Deep hydration - hyaluronic acid for a plump, dewy feel
- Antioxidant support - stable Vitamin C helps brighten the look of the skin
What to expect: skin feels smoother and softer from the first use; in the Matrixyl® 3000 studies, firmer, smoother-looking results were measured at 2 months.
custom.how_to_use:
Use morning and evening. After cleansing, press 3-4 drops onto slightly damp skin across the face and neck. Apply after any lighter, watery serums and before your moisturiser. Let it absorb for about a minute; finish with SPF in the morning.
Complete the routine: layer the Matrixyl 3000 Pro-Collagen Firming Cream on top - it contains the same Matrixyl 3000 peptides, so serum and cream work as a firming duo. Finish with SPF in the morning.
custom.clinical_research:
Matrixyl® 3000's two peptides raised collagen I by 256% in lab tests on skin cells.
The Matrixyl 3000 Firming Serum pairs Matrixyl® 3000 with palmitoyl pentapeptide-4, the original Matrixyl®:
- Collagen I +256% in lab tests, nearly 4× the stronger peptide alone
- Palmitoyl pentapeptide-4 reduced the look of wrinkles and fine lines more than placebo in a 12-week double-blind trial of 93 women
- Significant from week 8 in that trial, and still at week 12
- Both Matrixyl® 3000 peptides assessed safe in cosmetics by an independent expert panel
Lab: Sederma patent US 6,974,799 (human skin cells, 3 days). Trial: Robinson et al. 2005, run by Procter & Gamble scientists. Safety: Cosmetic Ingredient Review 2018. Results describe the ingredients, not this product.

custom.faq_items.question: What does the Matrixyl 3000 Firming Serum do?
custom.faq_items.answer: A firming serum with the Matrixyl 3000 peptide complex (Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1 and Tetrapeptide-7), stable vitamin C, niacinamide and hyaluronic acid. It supports firmer, smoother-looking skin and a reduced appearance of fine lines.

custom.faq_items.question: What is Matrixyl 3000?
custom.faq_items.answer: Matrixyl 3000 is a well-known matrikine peptide complex associated with the skin's natural collagen activity, valued in cosmetics for supporting a firmer, smoother appearance.

custom.faq_items.question: When and how do I use it?
custom.faq_items.answer: Use morning and/or evening on clean skin, 3-4 drops to face and neck, then moisturiser (and SPF 30+ in the morning). Hyaluronic acid works best on slightly damp skin.

custom.faq_items.question: Can I pair it with the Pro-Collagen Firming Cream?
custom.faq_items.answer: Yes. Apply the Matrixyl 3000 Firming Serum first, then seal with the Matrixyl 3000 Pro-Collagen Firming Cream for a complete firming routine.

custom.faq_items.question: How soon will I see results?
custom.faq_items.answer: Hydration and smoothness look improved quickly; a firmer, smoother appearance builds over 4-8 weeks, with best results around 12 weeks.

custom.faq_items.question: Is it suitable for sensitive skin?
custom.faq_items.answer: Formulated without parabens, mineral oil or added synthetic fragrance. We recommend a patch test first.

custom.how_to_steps.title: 1. Cleanse
custom.how_to_steps.description: Wash with a gentle, pH-balanced cleanser and pat skin dry.

custom.how_to_steps.title: 2. Apply Matrixyl 3000 Serum
custom.how_to_steps.description: Apply 3-4 drops to face and neck. Works best on slightly damp skin.

custom.how_to_steps.title: 3. Moisturise + SPF
custom.how_to_steps.description: Follow with your moisturiser. Finish with SPF 30+ every morning.
